reports.name: QSnb.fcu-1A
reports.note: auto-extracted in full-paper revisit, Nov 2026 (named in paper; placed from marker position: Zhao et al. 2019 J Genet (Table S1)); verify against paper In-silico position: QSnb.fcu-1A is the Snn4 locus (Table 3, peak at Snn4, 1AS). Snn4 lies 0.9 cM proximal to the EST markers XBG262267/XBG262975 and 1.6 cM distal to Xcfd58.1 (Abeysekara et al. 2009, Table 1 primers); in-silico PCR of the XBG262975 primers gives a 155 bp product at 1A 2,642,581 bp (RefSeq v1.0), and Xcfd58.1 sits next to Xcfa2153 (7.23 Mb), so Snn4 is placed at 2.64-7.23 Mb. The earlier placement at Xcfa2263 (186.8 Mb) was wrong: that marker flanks the 2A QTL. Nov 2026 (ad71.py).
